note: The bands the Extreme Flight 67 in CAP 580 plant has to land in, from docs/CAP580-STAGE1.md, which derives each from Extreme Flight's data sheet, T-Motor's measured bench table for the AM670 520 kV on the 18 x 8, APC's 18 x 8E data, the photographs of the aircraft and momentum theory (npm run cap580:derive prints the derived figures and fails when a `derived` here is not its own). Each width is the Extra 300 3D's for the same gate (tests/extra-thresholds.json), because the quantity carries the same kind of estimate; where the CAP's input is measured and the Extra's estimated, the width is no wider. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

c1_level_75.source: level speed at 75 percent throttle on the plant's thrust line and drag polar, derived 24.68; 12 percent either way, the Extra's: the thrust is measured here but cd0 is the Extra's estimate

c2_stall.source: sqrt(2W / rho S CLmax), derived 10.39 at the sheet's 8 lb on 860 sq in and CLmax 0.97 (the Extra's rule on XFOIL's NACA 0015 at 3e5); alphaStall is CLmax / CLalpha, 0.97 / 5.0601. The Extra's band in proportion, 0.94 to 1.14 of the formula

c3_glide.source: L/D at 15 m/s, derived 7.43, 12 percent either way, the Extra's

c4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 33.09 where APC's 18 x 8E curve (scaled to the bench's static thrust) meets the drag; 10 percent either way, the Extra's

c5_roll.source: pb/2V at full aileron on the high rate, Clda throw_a / -Clp, derived 0.4397 (533 deg/s at 18 m/s); 25 percent either way, the width Roskam's K' carries, the Extra's

c6_hover.source: hanging on the prop, the height held by the throttle: today's plant holds the weight at sqrt(W / T_static), derived 0.6144, 5 percent either way, the Extra's. T-Motor's bench table lifts the 3.63 kg at 0.535 throttle: its rpm at a throttle is not the throttle (0.60 of full at 50 percent), and the plant's steady rpm is; C6b prints the gap for the flight model lane rather than gating it

c7_vertical.source: straight up at full throttle, where the thrust line meets the weight and the zero lift drag, derived 21.97; 10 percent either way, the Extra's

c8_torque_roll.source: hanging at the hover throttle with the ailerons let go and the nose held on the rudder: the bench's 2.097 N m over its 94.3 N times the weight, 0.79 N m, less the wing root's share of the swirl (1 - SWIRL_KEEP, Selig, docs/FLIGHTMODEL.md), 0.59 N m net (the fin's counter roll goes with the side force the held rudder cancels, cap580:derive), against the air the turning airframe sweeps through (rot_k roll), derived 194 deg/s to the left; 25 percent either way, the Extra's

c9_aileron_hover.source: the same with full right aileron: the aileron's inboard share in the wash, 1.03 N m, beats the net torque, derived 169 deg/s right; 40 percent either way, the Extra's, the difference of two estimates

c10_zero_speed.source: hanging still, full up elevator and full right rudder from rest: the wash's dp on the surfaces' immersed shares, saturating on a flat plate (hi_alpha), derived 27.47 rad/s^2 in pitch and 14.91 in yaw; 25 percent either way, the Extra's. With the prop stopped the same sticks give under 5 percent of it

c11_harrier.source: level at 40 deg of angle of attack, the throttle holding height: the stalled wing's plate lift and the thrust's vertical share against the weight, derived 7.88 m/s at 0.585 throttle with the elevator at 56 percent of its throw; the speed 20 percent and the throttle 15 percent either way, the Extra's, and the elevator short of full

c12_knife_edge.source: rolled to 90 deg at 20 m/s, height held on the rudder: the fuselage and fin lifting sideways with the crossflow drag and the thrust's share along the yawed axis, derived 32.25 deg of sideslip at 0.757 throttle with the rudder at 84 percent of its throw; the sideslip 25 percent and the throttle 15 percent either way, the Extra's, and the rudder short of full

c13_rest.source: at rest on the photographed gear, 10.87 deg nose up (IMG_7289 reads 9 to 13), the CG 0.313 m up, 16.9 percent of the weight on the tailwheel; half a degree, 5 mm and 3.5 points either way, the Extra's

c14_takeoff.source: full throttle from standing, the tail up past 6 m/s and the nose to 8 deg at 1.2 times the stall: liftoff at 12.5 m/s after 4.0 m (cap580:derive); 40 percent short and 60 long, the Extra's

c15_unmoved.source: the Extra's, the Night Timber's and the Hercules' recorded flight hashes in Node as batch/2026-10-11's module flies them without the CAP; extra:gates E15 holds every other. The CAP adds a table and its own id, 32, and moves nothing else

c16_cross_host.source: the CAP's recorded take off, hover, torque roll and flight, state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome

c17_figures.source: the figure judge (src/game/figuredetect.js), fed every plant step as main.js feeds it on a fixed wing, names the 3D figures C6, C8 and C11 fly and a knife edge pass at 26 m/s, where its sideslip is under the 26 deg the judge allows (at C12's 20 m/s it holds 30 deg and is not named: the tricks lane's, docs/CAP580-STAGE1.md): what Free Flight's callouts and a Trick Battle room score
